connection_condition: each transaction row carries the account_id of the account it is posted on
description: An account is composed of the transactions posted on it; a transaction cannot exist without its account. All 4,500 accounts have at least one transaction.

connection_condition: loan.account_id references account.account_id
description: A loan contract belongs to exactly one account, and at most one loan exists per account in this database.

connection_condition: order.account_id references account.account_id
description: Standing orders are registered on an account and have no meaning without it; 6,471 orders are distributed over 3,758 accounts.

connection_condition: disp.account_id references account.account_id
description: An account is described by its disposition records: exactly one OWNER record and at most one DISPONENT record per account.

connection_condition: disp.client_id references client.client_id
description: A disposition record exists only in the context of a client; each client has exactly one disposition record.

connection_condition: there is no direct client-to-account column; the link is established indirectly through disp, where client_id and account_id meet on the same row
description: A client holds an account through a disposition record. In this database the link is effectively one-to-one: each client has exactly one disposition row and each account has exactly one owner.

connection_condition: no direct link exists; cards are reached from an account through its disp rows, and all 892 cards are attached to OWNER dispositions
description: Cards are issued against an account's ownership record rather than against the account directly.

connection_condition: account.district_id references district.district_id
description: Each account carries one district reference locating the account, with no orphan references across 4,500 accounts.

connection_condition: client.district_id references district.district_id
description: Each client carries a district reference that is independent of the district of the client's account: the two disagree for 409 of 4,500 ownership pairs.

connection_condition: all districts sharing the same A3 value belong to the same region group
description: A region group is composed of the districts that carry its A3 value; the 8 groups partition the 77 districts.

connection_condition: columns A4 through A16 sit on the same district row as district_id
description: Each district carries 13 coded aggregate indicator values; on account-level rows these cannot be combined with per-account measures without an aggregation step.

connection_condition: column A2 sits on the same district row as district_id
description: Each district has exactly one text label, which is the only human-readable district attribute in the database.

connection_condition: trans.type sits on the same row as trans_id
description: Every posted movement carries exactly one direction type, and that type is what determines whether the movement is an inflow or an outflow.

connection_condition: trans.operation sits on the same row as trans_id
description: Every posted movement carries an execution mode, which is recorded as null precisely for the monthly interest postings.

connection_condition: trans.k_symbol sits on the same row as trans_id
description: A transaction may carry a purpose code, but 481,881 of 1,056,320 rows have none and a further 53,433 carry a single-space placeholder.

connection_condition: order.k_symbol sits on the same row as order_id
description: Standing orders share the purpose code system with transactions, but the order column additionally uses a leasing code that never appears on transactions.

connection_condition: trans.bank is populated only when the movement is an inter-account transfer
description: Only inter-account transfers carry a counterparty bank code; cash deposits, cash withdrawals and card withdrawals never do.

connection_condition: order.bank_to identifies the bank holding the target account
description: Every standing order names a counterparty bank, using the same 13-code bank domain as inter-account transfers.

connection_condition: trans.account carries the remote account number of an inter-account transfer and never equals the row's own account_id
description: The counterparty account number belongs to a different numbering domain from account.account_id, so it identifies the remote side without enabling a join to local accounts.

connection_condition: order.account_to carries the remote account number and resolves to a local account only twice in 6,471 rows
description: As with transactions, the standing-order target account is an external number rather than a local account key.

connection_condition: loan.status sits on the same row as loan_id
description: Each loan contract carries one status code that separates finished contracts (A, B) from running contracts (C, D) without exception.

connection_condition: payments multiplied by duration reproduces amount exactly for all 682 contracts
description: The monthly payment is fully determined by the principal and the contractual duration; the portfolio therefore contains no interest loading in the stored payment figure.

connection_condition: add the number of months in loan.duration to loan.date
description: The maturity date is derived from the grant date and the contractual duration, and it is what separates the finished status codes from the running ones.

connection_condition: the mount is taken as positive for credit receipts and as negative for debit payments and withdrawals
description: The signed value is derived from the non-negative amount together with the direction type, because the stored amount never carries a sign.

connection_condition: subtract client.birth_date from a chosen reference date
description: Client age is derived from the stored birth date and depends on the reference date chosen for the analysis.

connection_condition: account.date sits on the same row as account_id and precedes the account's first transaction
description: Each account has an opening date that bounds the start of its transaction history.

connection_condition: disp.type sits on the same row as disp_id
description: Each disposition record states one role on one account, and the OWNER role occurs exactly once per account.
